```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.show = 'hide')

library(tidyverse)
library(mixOmics)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(vegan)
library(tibble)
library(CoDaSeq)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r Unkown Samples}
biomarkers <- read_csv("Untargeted_biomarkers_level3.csv")
Lib_search <- read_tsv("Urine_librarymatch_500foods.tsv")
#biomarkers <- read_csv("UK_biomarkers_samplegroup.csv")
#Lib_search <- read_tsv("Urine_UK_librarymatch_analog.tsv")
metadata <- read_csv("IPENS_metadata.csv")
Lib_search <- Lib_search[,c("#Scan#", "Node")]
colnames(biomarkers)[colnames(biomarkers) == "feature"] <- "Node"
Biomarker_hits <- Lib_search %>% left_join(biomarkers, by = c("Node"))

Sample_featuretable <- read_csv("featuretable_MXP_normalized.csv")
Sample_featuretable$`row ID` <- gsub("CN_", "", Sample_featuretable$`row ID`)
Sample_featuretable[is.na(Sample_featuretable)] <- 0

#data_transpose
Sample_transpose <- Sample_featuretable %>% 
  column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains(".mzML")) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("filename")


#remove Peak area from filename from feature table
Sample_transpose$filename <- gsub(" Peak area", "", Sample_transpose$filename)
Sample_transpose <- Sample_transpose %>% arrange(filename)

#TIC normalisation
# Set the row names using the 'filename' column
Sample_tic <- column_to_rownames(Sample_transpose, var = "filename")
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic + 1
Sample_tic <- sweep(Sample_tic, 1, rowSums(Sample_tic), FUN = "/")
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic * 1e3
Sample_tic <- as.data.frame(Sample_tic)
Sample_tic <- t(Sample_tic) %>% as.data.frame()
# Bring row names into a column called "row ID"
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic %>% rownames_to_column("row ID")

#rclr normalisation
Sample_clr <- codaSeq.clr(column_to_rownames(Sample_transpose, var = "filename") + 1) %>% as.data.frame()
Sample_clr <- Sample_clr %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
Sample_clr <- Sample_clr %>% rownames_to_column("row ID")

Biomarkers_in_samples <- Sample_tic %>%
  filter(`row ID` %in% Lib_search$`#Scan#`)

Biomarkers_in_samples <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>% 
  column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains(".mzML")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("#Scan#")

Biomarker_hits$`#Scan#` <- as.character(Biomarker_hits$`#Scan#`)
Biomarkers_in_samples <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>% left_join(Biomarker_hits, by = "#Scan#" )
Biomarkers_in_samples <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>% na.omit(Biomarkers_in_samples$category)
df_foods <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>%
  separate_rows(category, sep = ", ") 

food_summarized <- df_foods %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(contains("mzmL"), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

food_summarized <- food_summarized %>% column_to_rownames("category") 
food_summarized <- food_summarized %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
food_summarized <- food_summarized %>% rownames_to_column("filename")
food_summarized <- food_summarized %>% filter(str_detect(filename, "IPEN"))

food_summarized$filename <- gsub("Peak area", "", food_summarized$filename)

#write.csv(food_summarized, "IPENS_500food_summerized.csv", row.names = FALSE)

metadata <- metadata %>% filter(str_detect(ATTRIBUTE_Study, "CD-TREAT")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(filename, "IPENS807D.mzML")) %>% filter(str_detect(ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint, "A|B|C"))

metadata$filename <- trimws(metadata$filename)
food_summarized$filename <- trimws(food_summarized$filename)
metadata$filename <- as.character(metadata$filename)
food_summarized$filename <- as.character(food_summarized$filename)

# Filter food_summarized to keep only filenames present in metadata
food_summarized_common <- food_summarized %>%
  filter(filename %in% metadata$filename)

# Merge only the common filenames
food_metadata <- merge(metadata, food_summarized_common, by = "filename")


long_format <- food_metadata %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(filename, ATTRIBUTE_SampleType, ATTRIBUTE_Study, ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint), names_to = "Category", values_to = "Intensity")


bar_plot <- ggplot(long_format, aes(x = ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint, y = Intensity, color = ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1, alpha = 0.7)+
  facet_wrap(~Category, scales = "free_y")+
  theme_bw() +  # Clean theme
  labs(
    title = "Dietary readout of Urine_UK Samples",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6), # Rotate x-axis labels
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold") # Adjust facet label size
  )

print(bar_plot)

#ggsave("Dietaryreadout_IPENS_level5.png", plot = bar_plot ,dpi = 300, width = 20, height = 12)

```

```{r food readout}
food_read <- food_summarized %>% arrange(filename) %>% filter(food_summarized$filename %in% metadata$filename)
#write.csv(food_summarized_common, "CD-TREAT_urine_diet_readout.csv", row.names = FALSE)

clr_data <- Sample_clr %>% column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("filename")
clr_data <- clr_data %>% filter(clr_data$filename %in% metadata$filename)
#PCA analysis#
PCA_whole <- mixOmics::pca(clr_data, ncomp = 4, scale = TRUE)
PCA_whole_scores <- data.frame(PCA_whole$variates$X, metadata)
PCA_whole_scores <- PCA_whole_scores
PCA_plot <- PCA_whole_scores %>%
  ggscatter(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint", alpha = 0.9, size = 2,
            title = paste("PCA", "diet scores", sep = " "),
            xlab = paste("PC1 (", round(PCA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[1]*100, digits = 2),"%)", sep = ""), 
            ylab = paste("PC2 (", round(PCA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[2]*100, digits = 2),"%)", sep = ""),
            ggtheme = theme_bw()) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(colour = ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint), alpha = 1) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 1.5)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("A" = "#05f2d7", "B" = "#f2d705", "C" = "red")  # Custom colors for W12 and W24
  )

print(PCA_plot)

#ggsave("PCA_CD-TREAT_diet_scores.svg", plot = PCA_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)


#PERMANOVA
clr_data <- clr_data %>% column_to_rownames("filename")
dist_metabolites_clr <- vegdist(clr_data, method = "euclidean")
permanova_clr <- adonis2(dist_metabolites_clr ~ PCA_whole_scores$ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint, PCA_whole_scores, na.action = na.omit)

print(permanova_clr)

permanova <- adonis2(dist_metabolites_clr ~ 
                          UniqueSubjectID + timepoint,
                          data = PCA_whole_scores, 
                          na.action = na.omit,
                          by = "terms")

print(permanova)


```

```{r PLSDA}

# Ensure the grouping variable is a factor
PCA_whole_scores$ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint <- as.factor(PCA_whole_scores$ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint)
clr_data <- clr_data %>% column_to_rownames("filename")%>% dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))
#PLS_DA
PLSDA_whole <- mixOmics::plsda(clr_data,PCA_whole_scores$ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint, ncomp = 5, scale = TRUE)
PLSDA_whole_scores <- data.frame(PLSDA_whole$variates$X) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("filename") 
PLSDA_whole_scores$filename <- trimws(PLSDA_whole_scores$filename)
PLSDA_whole_scores <- PLSDA_whole_scores %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "filename")


PLSDA_incubation_time <- PLSDA_whole_scores %>%
  ggscatter(
    x = "comp1", 
    y = "comp2", 
    color = "ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint", 
    alpha = 1,
    size = 2.5,
    title = "CD-TREAT_Urine",
    xlab = paste("Component 1 (", round(PLSDA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[1]*100, digits = 1),"%)", sep = ""), 
    ylab = paste("Component 2 (", round(PLSDA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[2]*100, digits = 1),"%)", sep = ""),
    legend.title = "Group", 
    ggtheme = theme_bw()
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(color = ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint),
    alpha = 1,   # Adjust transparency of the ellipse
    type = "t"     # Type "t" fits the ellipse to a t-distribution
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = PLSDA_whole_scores %>% 
      group_by(ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint) %>% 
      summarise(across(matches("Comp"), mean)),  # Calculate mean PC1 and PC2
    aes(comp1, comp2, color = ATTRIBUTE_Study_Timepoint), 
    size = 4, 
    shape = 8  # Star-shaped marker for centroids
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("A" = "#05f2d7", "B" = "#f2d705", "C" = "red")  # Custom colors for W12 and W24
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 1.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),# Adjust border color and thickness here
  ) + 
  coord_fixed()

print(PLSDA_incubation_time)

#ggsave("PLSDA_CD-TREAT_clr_data.svg", plot = PLSDA_incubation_time, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)

vip_scores <- mixOmics::vip(PLSDA_whole) %>% as.data.frame()
loadings   <- as.data.frame(PLSDA_whole$loadings$X)
vip_comp1 <- vip_scores[, "comp1"]

str(vip_scores)
head(vip_scores)

vip_results <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(vip_scores),
    VIP_comp1 = vip_scores[, "comp1"],
    Loading_comp1 = loadings[, "comp1"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

library_matches <- read_tsv("merged_results_with_gnps.tsv")
library_matches$Feature <- as.character(library_matches$`#Scan#`)

vip_results <- vip_results %>%
  left_join(library_matches, by = "Feature")


```
